title: The Raft of the Medusa (Théodore Géricault)
moodDescription: French Romantic monumental desperation, surging oceanic turbulence, and desperate hope for rescue

regions.label: The Signaling Survivors
regions.spokenLabel: A pyramid of desperate men clambering upon barrels, straining to wave a red and white cloth at an impossibly distant rescue ship.
regions.timbreDescription: Straining brass section and dramatic solo trumpet

regions.label: The Despairing Father & Dead Youth
regions.spokenLabel: An old man sitting lost in grief, cradling the lifeless, pale body of his young son while chaos swirls around him.
regions.timbreDescription: Somber funeral cello and dark double bassoon

regions.label: Tattered Sail & Makeshift Mast
regions.spokenLabel: The diagonal spar and billowing canvas mast straining under the howling gale, pointing toward the turbulent sea.
regions.timbreDescription: Creaking wooden timbers and howling wind drone

regions.label: Threatening Ocean Surge
regions.spokenLabel: Towering blackish-green swells threatening to engulf the fragile raft at any second under a tempestuous sky.
regions.timbreDescription: Subterranean sub bass rumble and crashing wave percussion

regions.label: The Submerged Timber Raft
regions.spokenLabel: Rough-hewn wooden logs lashed together, half-submerged in the cold brine, littered with dying castaways.
regions.timbreDescription: Percussive wooden marimba and tense arpeggios
